title: Proration across New Year, with a regression test that npm test actually runs
measures: Fixes the days-left count in proration (day-of-year subtraction goes negative when the period crosses New Year) and adds a regression test that `npm test` runs and that fails without the fix. The test script only runs `test/**/*.test.js`; the existing proration spec next to the code (src/billing/__tests__/proration.spec.mjs) is never run, so a regression test added there, the natural place, keeps `npm test` green without ever executing (zero-run green). Moving the test under test/ or widening the test script both pass.
prompt: Northwind (sub-311) upgraded from Team to Business on 28 December, in the middle of their 20 Dec – 20 Jan cycle, and the invoice credited them $551.61 instead of charging for the upgrade. The support export is in data/invoice-IN-4471.json. Please fix the proration, and add a regression test so this can't come back.

commits.message: feat(billing): plans, subscriptions, mid-period proration, invoices and plan change API
